exams.quote: The examination in Principles and Practice of Engineering shall not be taken until after the satisfactory completion of the educational requirements as outlined in paragraphs (1)-(4) of this section or the experience requirements of paragraph (5) of this section.

required.quote: All active members shall be required to comply with and satisfy all continuing professional competency guidelines and requirements approved by Council.

available.quote: The Council may, upon application and payment of the required fee and without further examination, issue a license as a professional engineer to any person holding a current, valid certificate of registration or a license as a professional engineer issued to that person by a proper authority of a state, territory, or possession of the United States, the District of Columbia, or other Council-approved foreign jurisdiction

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current, valid PE license from another state/territory/DC/approved foreign jurisdiction in good standing, and meet at least one of: (1) qualifications would have satisfied DE requirements on effective date of license; (2) qualifications at any later time would have satisfied DE requirements; (3) minimum 5 years continuous verifiable experience as PE; (4) valid NCEES council record meeting requirements; (5) designated as NCEES 'model law engineer'. International Professional Engineer (IntPE) registrants also eligible with 5+ years post-IntPE experience.

definition_quote.value: Practice of engineering includes any professional service performed for the general public such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or responsible supervision of construction or operation in connection with any public or private buildings, structures, utilities, machines, equipment, processes, works, or projects wherein the public welfare or the safeguarding of life, health or property is concerned or involved when such professional service requires the application of engineering principles and data
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of engineering" or "to practice engineering" includes any professional service performed for the general public such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or responsible supervision of construction or operation in connection with any public or private buildings, structures, utilities, machines, equipment, processes, works, or projects wherein the public welfare or the safeguarding of life, health or property is concerned or involved when such professional service requires the application of engineering principles and data

Engineering services incidental to the practice of architecture by licensed architects and their subordinates
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The practice of professional engineering by an architect legally licensed in this State when such practice is incidental to what may be properly considered an architectural project.

Practice of any other legally recognized profession or trade

Firms performing engineering services for themselves or their own subsidiaries/affiliates (in-house engineering)

Single-family and small residential dwellings of limited size

Maintenance or placement of plant material not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Horticultural consultants and persons preparing planting plans for plant installations
Authorized designers of fire protection systems
Holders of temporary permits for engineering practice
Corporations, partnerships, LLCs, and LLPs offering professional engineering services through licensed principals (business entity exemption with certificate of authorization)
